facets.description: i18n.rb:17 calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym, which raises NoMethodError when default_locale is nil, before compact can remove it
FallbackLocaleList#[] mixes String and Symbol locales (e.g. "en" vs :en), which breaks uniq and makes the @loaded_locales.include? check miss

answer.reasoning: The two labelers disagree only on how to split the String/Symbol problem. Mixing String and Symbol locales on line 17 is one defect at one location. Breaking uniq and missing the @loaded_locales check are two results of that same defect, and fixing it means normalizing the types in one place. So there are two facets: the nil default_locale crash and the String/Symbol mixing. s_e63608d7 reports both: it says calling to_sym before compact defeats the nil guard, and it says the list mixes String and Symbol so uniq/dedup fails. That makes it complete. s_c8aed49e reports only the mixed types and the cache misses. Its nil handling is about `locale`, not default_locale, and it appears only in the fix. s_9009c9ce reports only the nil crash. s_006ed08a reports both facets.
